contextReview.basis: Direct review: overcast daytime East Asian urban shopping streets with small tiled building walls, bakery and shop windows, canvas awnings, utility poles and stone paving; no rain depicted and reflective paving is not read as rain; humidity not inferred. Mixed adult model casting is independent of the location.

casting.castingPolicy: mixed adult model appearance independent of the East Asian urban location (user 2026-11-03)

approval.evidence: Five editorials passed producer QA and continued under the user's standing workflow authorization (2026-11-03, "앞으로도 승인 없이 진행"); the user did not visually approve them individually. Product images passed producer technical QA and producer visual QA on four backgrounds only.

reconstructionNotice: The bakery cart, bread and packaging are scene props, not products. Turned sideways: the charcoal coat's far side and back, the black ribbed knit below the coat front and the navy trousers' waist are conservatively reconstructed. The black tote hangs from one hand, so its far side is inferred. No socks are visible, so none are listed. Brand, fibre composition and retail identity are unknown.

findings: Actual view_image review of all five look overview sheets; all 28 isolated products, complete pairs and straps, no outfit collages or props; clean final composites on four backgrounds.

deck.ko: 차콜 패치 포켓과 검정 리브 니트의 질감.
deck.en: Charcoal patch pockets meet black rib texture.
deck.de: Anthrazitfarbene Taschen treffen auf schwarzen Rippstrick.

intro.ko: 지나가는 카트에 자리를 내주며 몸을 옆으로 틉니다.
intro.en: He turns sideways to make room for a passing cart.
intro.de: Er dreht sich seitlich, um einem vorbeifahrenden Wagen Platz zu machen.

body.ko: 큰 패치 포켓의 짧은 차콜 코트가 검정 리브 니트 위에 놓입니다. 네이비 발목 바지는 검정 첼시 부츠로 마무리되고 긴 손잡이 토트는 반대쪽 손에 들립니다. 단순한 어두운 면들이 플래시 아래 서로 다른 결로 읽힙니다.
body.en: A short charcoal coat with large patch pockets sits over a black ribbed knit. Navy ankle trousers end at black Chelsea boots; a long-handled tote rests in the opposite hand. Direct flash gives the simple dark surfaces distinct textures.
body.de: Ein kurzer Anthrazitmantel mit großen aufgesetzten Taschen liegt über schwarzem Rippstrick. Marineblaue Knöchelhosen enden an schwarzen Chelseaboots; der Shopper hängt in der anderen Hand. Direkter Blitz macht unterschiedliche Strukturen in den schlichten dunklen Flächen sichtbar.

pull.en: Texture becomes visible within dark tones.
pull.de: Struktur zeigt sich innerhalb dunkler Töne.

copy.pullQuoteEn: Texture becomes visible within dark tones.

tip.ko: 토트를 카트 반대쪽으로 옮기고 부츠 입구에 바지 밑단이 걸리지 않게 하세요.
tip.en: Move the tote away from the cart and keep trouser hems clear of boot openings.
tip.de: Den Shopper vom Wagen wegtragen und die Hosensäume frei von den Schaftöffnungen halten.

description.de: Kurzer Mantel mit breitem Kragen und zwei großen aufgesetzten Taschen.

howToWear.ko: 카트를 비켜설 때 앞을 열어 발 움직임을 편하게 두세요.
howToWear.en: Wear open for an easy sidestep around the cart.
